title: Mini SurrealSkin® Waterproof Setting Spray with 16HR Wear
descriptionHtml:
✓ Hydrating✓ Long-wearing✓ Fragrance Free✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Hyaluronic Acid

What it is: A mini alcohol-free, fragrance-free, and butane-free ultra-fine hydrating mist to set makeup for up to 16 hours for a natural finish and barely-there feel.


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Hyaluronic Acid: Helps with immediate and all-day hydration.

- Niacinamide: Known to help even out skin tone.

- Vitamin C: Known for its antioxidant properties.


Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, and triclosan. It is also vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-This ultrafine mist can be applied close to the skin without disrupting makeup.
​-As a last step to your makeup routine, mist it all over the face a few times to coat the skin evenly.​ ​​​

Mario’s Tip:​
-Hold the bottle about six inches away from your face, spray in three even lines, let it dry for a few seconds.
Ingredients+
-Hyaluronic Acid: Helps with immediate and all-day hydration.
-Niacinamide: Known to help even out skin tone.
-Vitamin C: Known for its antioxidant properties.

Water/Aqua, PVP, Phenoxyethanol, 1,2-Hexanediol, Niacinamide, Butylene Glycol, 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, Sodium Citrate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Citric Acid, Caffeine, Glycerin, Hyaluronic Acid, Sodium Lauroyl Lactylate, Hydroxypropyltrimonium Hyaluronate, Hippophae Rhamnoides Extract, Ceramide NP, Ceramide AP, Phytosphingosine, Alteromonas Ferment Extract, Cholesterol, Xanthan Gum, Carbomer, Vaccinium Corymbosum (Blueberry) Fruit Extract, Euterpe Oleracea Fruit Extract, Ceramide EOP.
